The core failure mode is that the shuffle and split tests were incorrectly implemented as *stability checks* rather than genuine falsification tests. They used a model-blind statistic (the absolute value of the effect size) that remains unchanged under label permutation, rendering them incapable of detecting a model that merely predicts noise. This breaks the fundamental Honesty Law #5 requirement that a kill test must respond to the model's predictions. The fix transforms the shuffle test into a proper permutation test for exchangeability, using the mean log-likelihood ratio as the test statistic, which directly measures the predictive information provided by the model. The split test now also uses this model-aware statistic to assess calibration stability across chronological halves, ensuring that the entire funnel genuinely evaluates the model's informational content.
